description.value: Table: Summon Nature's Ally IV Creature Subtype(s) Black Shark (Aquatic) Black Widow — Blood Bat (Avian) Cait Sith (3 MP) — Elemental (Medium) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Fire Lizard (1/day Breath) (Fire, Reptilian) Flying Killer — Gloom Spider — Hornet — Ice Lizard (1/day Breath) (Ice, Reptilian) Rough Viper — Sabertusk — Sea Scorpion — Stunner — Werewolf — Wisp (3 MP) (Non-element) This spell functions like Summon Nature’s Ally I , except that you can summon one creature from the 4th-level list with a CR rating of 4 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 3rd-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 2nd-level or lower lists.
